title: Quantum Phaselift
summary: Estimating quantum time-series such as the Loschmidt amplitude $f(t)=\langleψ|\mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{i}Ht}|ψ\rangle$ is central to spectroscopy, Hamiltonian analysis, and many phase-estimation algorithms. Direct estimation via the Hadamard test requires controlled implementations of $\mathrm{e}^{-\mathrm{i}Ht}$, and the depth of these controlled circuits grows with $t$, making long-time estimation challenging on near-term hardware.
